description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionConflictException class, which is a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signal that a connection with a specific ID already exists but is not available at the moment. The class is part of the connectivity exceptions package and extends DittoRuntimeException, implementing the ConnectivityException interface. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, as well as a nested builder class for fluent creation of exception instances.
